report_identity.report_title: Guangdong Kanghua Healthcare Group Co., Ltd. Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group provides hospital services, rehabilitation and other healthcare services, haemodialysis services and elderly healthcare services in Mainland China.
business_overview.revenue_model: Medical and care services are recognised over time as services are rendered; patients pay by cash, cards, mobile payment, government social insurance schemes and corporate settlement.
business_notes: Hospital revenue declined 2.1% year on year, affected by lower outpatient and inpatient visits, policy pressure on medical charges and local competition.
Haemodialysis revenue grew 17.3% but management states the segment was still loss-making.

non_recurring_items.item: Net gain on disposal of subsidiaries
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Disposal gain from Kangxin Hospital and other subsidiaries, not core recurring operating cash profit.
non_recurring_items.source: Consolidated profit or loss page 181; note 35(a)

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value gain on financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value gain on investment fund or structured products, non-operating.

non_recurring_items.item: Investment income from financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Dividend or interest income from financial assets at FVTPL, mainly structured bank deposits.
Interest income from bank deposits, non-operating for core healthcare service earnings.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and bank balances of the consolidated PRC healthcare group.
funds_assets.source: Consolidated statement of financial position pages 183-184; note 22 page 251

funds_assets.business_substance: Fixed bank deposits with original maturity over three months and rates of 3.05%-5.70%.
Deposits tied to social insurance quality assessment, IPO proceeds approval and guarantee deposit.
PRC commercial bank structured deposits with maturities less than six months and variable returns, renewed at maturity.

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables and prepayments from hospital operations, social insurance settlement and corporate customers.
Hospitals, medical facilities and equipment used in healthcare services.
Leasehold land and leased land/buildings used in operations.
operating_assets.source: Balance sheet page 183; management discussion page 42

operating_assets.item: Deposits paid for acquisition of property, plant and equipment
operating_assets.business_substance: Deposits for construction cost and medical equipment/facilities.
operating_assets.source: Balance sheet page 183; management discussion page 43

investment_assets.business_substance: Seven-year PRC limited partnership investing in unlisted healthcare-related companies.
Chongqing phase 1 medical facility leased to Kangxin Hospital; level 3 fair value using income approach.

other_assets.business_substance: Goodwill allocated to Anhui Hualin and Kanghua Haemodialysis CGUs.

financing_liabilities.item: Bank loans due within one year
Bank loans due after one year
financing_liabilities.business_substance: Non-current bank loans, including secured Qingxi complex financing and unsecured operating cash flow loan for Kanghua Hospital.
IFRS 16 lease liabilities for operating properties; continuing operating obligation rather than separately deducted debt in the owner-earnback main cash bridge.

operating_liabilities.item: Accounts and other payables and provision
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Includes accounts payable, accrued expenses, receipts in advance, PPE payables and medical dispute provision.
Customer advances included in receipts in advance.

operating_liabilities.item: Advances from PRC social insurance bureau
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Social insurance bureau advances for daily hospital operations.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit in 2024-2025, but the hospital business remains capital intensive and 2025 profit included disposal/fair-value/investment income while receivable ECL increased.

gaps: Annual report text did not split bank balances and fixed deposits by listed parent, Hong Kong account, Mainland subsidiaries or individual hospital/VIE entity.

Structured bank deposits are disclosed as PRC commercial bank deposits with maturities less than six months, but principal-protection terms and counterparty names were not fully available in extracted text.
No precise management disclosure of minimum operating cash required by hospitals; owner-earnback analysis uses a conservative estimate.
2025 report is available in local raw filing archive, but no separate HKEX/company source URL was present in metadata.
